title: Qiushi Engine on AstaBench E2E-Bench-Hard
abstract: arXiv:2609.08196v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: This report analyzes Qiushi Engine v0.8 across all 40 test tasks in AstaBench E2E-Bench-Hard, a benchmark that requires autonomous agents to carry a research question through experimental design, code implementation, actual execution, result analysis, and report delivery. Qiushi Engine is model-configurable; this evaluation selected DeepSeek deepseek-v4pro-preview as the model backend. The official AstaBench leaderboard records a score of 0.816 and an average benchmark cost of USD 15.209 per task, while the full-precision local recomputation is $81.59 \pm 1.87$. Four tasks satisfied every rubric item, yielding a full-task completion rate of 4/40 = 10% -- 7 percentage points above, and about 3.3 times, the approximately 3% best rate reported for AstaBench's official agents. Across 507 required rubric items, 416 were satisfied (82.1%). Official scoring archives and 40 Meta-Trace records show sustained production and verification of reports

translated_title: 求是引擎在 AstaBench E2E-Bench-Hard 上的表现
translated_abstract: 本报告分析了求是引擎 v0.8 在 AstaBench E2E-Bench-Hard 基准测试全部 40 个测试任务上的表现。该基准要求自主智能体将一个研究问题贯穿实验设计、代码实现、实际执行、结果分析和报告交付的完整流程。求是引擎支持模型可配置，本次评估选用 DeepSeek deepseek-v4pro-preview 作为模型后端。AstaBench 官方排行榜记录其得分为 0.816，每个任务的平均基准测试成本为 15.209 美元，而全精度本地复算结果为 81.59 ± 1.87。共有四个任务满足了所有评分细则项，完整任务完成率为 4/40 = 10%，比 AstaBench 官方智能体报告的约 3% 最佳完成率高出 7 个百分点，约为其 3.3 倍。在全部 507 个必需的评分细则项中，有 416 项得到满足（82.1%）。官方评分存档和 40 份 Meta-Trace 记录表明，报告能够持续生成并通过验证。
tldr: 求是引擎 v0.8 在要求端到端完成科研全流程的 AstaBench E2E-Bench-Hard 基准上取得 0.816 的得分和 10% 的完整任务完成率，约为官方最佳智能体的 3.3 倍，展现了领先的自主科研能力。
en_tdlr: Qiushi Engine v0.8 achieved a score of 0.816 and a 10% full-task completion rate on the end-to-end research benchmark AstaBench E2E-Bench-Hard, roughly 3.3 times the best rate of official agents, demonstrating leading autonomous research capabilities.
